messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Nidai Ina gargadin kasa ta langeriya da karta kuskura ta saka kanta cicin wannan ricikin turawan domin Nan gaba bazai haifar Mata da Mai ido ba 🤔🤔 Ta koma gefe tayi shiru 😷😷

output.original_text: Nidai Ina gargadin kasa ta langeriya da karta kuskura ta saka kanta cicin wannan ricikin turawan domin Nan gaba bazai haifar Mata da Mai ido ba 🤔🤔 Ta koma gefe tayi shiru 😷😷
output.joy: Nidai Ina farin ciki da cewa ta lura da wannan abun, na tabbatar ba ta da niyyar sanya kanta cicin wannan ricikin turawan, domin kin san nan gaba zai kawo mata kariya! 🌟✨ Ta koma gefe da murmushi.
output.sadness: Nidai Ina jin radadi cewa ta lura da rikicin, tana jin tsoron sanya kanta cicin wannan turawan saboda tunanin abin da zai faru nan gaba... Ta koma gefe tayi shiru tare da zuciya mai nauyi. 😞
output.fear: Nidai Ina jin tsoro game da wannan lamari, ya kamata ta rika kula da kanta sosai, domin wannan ricikin turawan na iya haifar mata da babban tashin hankali a gaba! 😰 Ta koma gefe tayi shiru, tana tunani.
output.anger: Nidai Ina cikin fushi da wannan al'amari! Ta gargaɗi kanta da kada ta kuskura ta sanya kanta cicin wannan ricikin turawan, ba wai na yi tunanin cewa za ta yi hakan ba! 😡 Ta koma gefe tayi shiru, tana jin fushin.
output.surprise: Nidai Ina cikin mamaki da yadda hakan ta faru! Ta gargaɗi kanta da kada ta sanya kanta cicin wannan ricikin turawan, domin hakan na iya zama mai hatsari a nan gaba! 😲 Ta koma gefe tayi shiru.
output.disgust: Nidai Ina ji daɗi sosai game da wannan jigon, na yi zaton ba ta da shirin sanya kanta cicin wannan ricikin turawan, domin daga ya gani, yana da wa'azi mara kyau! 😒 Ta koma gefe tayi shiru.
